definitions.explanation: Multiple musicians playing instruments together. Refers to the act of performing as a group or the resulting performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合奏|がっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We all play together as an ensemble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{合奏|がっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We practiced ensemble playing in music class.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦リコーダー→リコーダー：28505_rikoodaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合奏|がっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}して→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The children performed a recorder ensemble for us.

notes:
{合奏|がっそう} means playing music together as a group. Composed of {合|がっ} (together) + {奏|そう} (play music). Used as both a noun and a suru verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合奏|がっそう}{曲|きょく}: ensemble piece
- {合奏|がっそう}⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: ensemble practice
- {合奏|がっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}する→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧: to perform an ensemble piece
- {合奏|がっそう}⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧: ensemble group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独奏|どくそう}→独奏：07539_dokusou⟧: solo (one person playing an instrument)
- ⟦{合唱|がっしょう}→合唱：04900_gasshou⟧: chorus/choir (singing together — vocal, not instrumental)
- ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: musical performance (general term, solo or group)
- {連弾|れんだん}: piano duet (two people at one piano)

USAGE:
{合奏|がっそう} is especially common in school music education, where students practice ensemble playing with recorders, keyboards, and other instruments.
